title: ForgeJSONGD
key_points: Simplifies Godot save/load systems with a GDScript singleton.
Allows serialization of any class to JSON and deserialization back, automatically handling Godot types.
Provides advanced tools for comparing, finding differences, and applying patches to game or app data.
Supports saving JSON data to files with optional encryption.
Can load JSON data from files with optional decryption.
limitations: Only properties marked with @export are serialized by default in GDScript. All script variables are serialized if not set.
In C#, only properties marked with the [Export] attribute will be serialized.
Implement robust error handling to catch potential issues like file loading failures or JSON parsing errors.
To prevent security vulnerabilities, encrypt your JSON data.
asserts: The source claims that it can simplify save/load systems in Godot by providing a GDScript singleton which allows the easy serialization and deserialization of class objects to and from JSON format, along with additional tools for comparing and manipulating JSON data.
